label: support-truist.vercel.app
title: Truist bank store
reasons: Impersonates Truist Bank with branding, logo styling, and truist.com-lookalike layout, asking visitors to 'Verify your account numnber' as a login prompt
Collects username, password, access code (account number), full name, phone number, and address across three screens, then POSTs all fields to a Telegram bot API endpoint

Source code shows explicit exfiltration: constructs message labeled 'TRUIST B@NK LOG' with every field and sends to api.telegram.org/bot8840171024:AAEqvEUmJFW9Nc64_RcsColPn7MQGIvvWwY/sendMessage, then redirects victim to real truist.com to conceal the theft

label: defixs-finance.vercel.app
title: Defix-Finance | One-Stop DeFi Solution
reasons: The bundled JavaScript contains an input field named 'seedPhrase' within a page that offers to 'rectify all strange wallet issues' and 'claim airdrop'.
The page's visible copy promises to fix wallet problems and resolve missing balances, creating a pretext for visitors to enter sensitive recovery phrases.
The application presents a wallet picker referencing real brands (Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect) as part of a flow that culminates in the seedPhrase field.

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app

The wallet connection dialog contains a specific WalletLink URL with parameters that would link a user's Coinbase Wallet to the attacker's session: 'https://www.walletlink.org/#/link?id=aca191c9768dfc0eace0b03dc861a094&secret=d14b2f03bee76a78f002f9da105461d0eb853465b9b494a2ffbd81bc0d407fd1&server=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.walletlink.org&v=3.7.2&chainId=1'

label: pay-mail.github.io/PHP-based

label: mohmmedretuio12-hash.github.io/instagram-page

label: citi-bank-new.vercel.app
title: CITI BANK | Online Banking
reasons: The page impersonates Citi Bank with visible branding ('CITI BANK | Online Banking') and a login form labeled 'Sign In to Online Banking' that asks for 'Online ID or Email' and 'Passcode'.
The page contains credential-harvesting input fields (login-username and login-password) designed to capture banking login credentials.
The page displays a fake banking portal with account balances and transaction forms to lure the visitor into entering real credentials into the phishing login form.
